title: Reef (Square) Knot Dual-Throw Topology & Anti-Granny Rule
summary: Binding two rope ends by crossing Right-over-Left followed by Left-over-Right to form symmetrical interlocking bights that lock under tension.

claims.statement: Step 1: Cross active working end right-over-left and wrap under once to create the foundational half-knot.

evidence_refs.cue_excerpt: Cross active working end right-over-left and wrap under once to create the foundational half-knot.

claims.statement: Step 2: The second throw must cross Left-over-Right (the exact reverse of throw 1). Repeating right-over-left produces an unstable Granny Knot.

evidence_refs.cue_excerpt: The second throw must cross Left-over-Right (the exact reverse of throw 1). Repeating right-over-left produces an unstable Granny Knot.
